resources.string: A letter from the developer
Hello,\nI'm the developer of 1 Day 1 Diary 👋

Every review about a diary lost after changing phones weighed on me. So I rebuilt the app **from scratch**. Now **even your photos are backed up**.\n\nTo keep caring for this app, I've decided to add ads and paid features. In return, I promise two things.

I built this app in the summer of 2021, while first learning Android. Somehow **more than 100,000 people** have downloaded it since. It still makes me a little nervous that years of someone's days live inside an app I made.

But many reviews made my heart sink. Posts saying a diary disappeared after changing phones, or that all the photos were suddenly gone. Looking after the app alone alongside my day job, I left those problems unsolved for too long. I'm truly sorry to everyone who lost precious records.

So this time I rebuilt the app from scratch. What I spent the longest on was making sure records never disappear. Photos now live in a place they won't be erased from, and backups include them. This update moved your original records as they are, without touching them. It also works well on tablets, and an iPhone version is on the way.

There's one thing I want to be honest about. I was grateful for every review saying it's great because it's free with no ads, so I thought about this for a long time. Building this in my spare time often meant slow updates. To care for the app longer and more often, I decided to add ads and paid features.

Here's my promise in return. Everything you've been using stays free, including backups with photos. The screens where you write and read have no ads. Your diary stays on your phone and the Drive you choose, and not a single word of it ever reaches me. If ads bother you, a one-time payment removes them.

I still read every review and email. Please leave a line today too. Keeping that line safe is what I wanted most from this update. 🙂
From the developer of 1 Day 1 Diary
